Translation.Please enter your username and password: Please enter your username and password
Translation.Video Subject Placeholder: Example: How AI is changing everyday life
Translation.Script Style Help: How the AI words the script. Default is simple, humanized language; pick a different style to change the tone and vocabulary.
Translation.Custom Script Requirements Placeholder: Example: use a lighter tone, fit TikTok style, target young viewers, make the opening more suspenseful
Translation.Video Script Help: Leave blank to generate it with AI from the video subject. Proper punctuation helps generate subtitles.
Translation.Please Enter the Video Subject: Please Enter the Video Script First
Translation.Please Enter the Video Subject First: Please enter the video subject first
Translation.No Tasks Match Filter: No tasks match the selected filter
Translation.Generating Video Script and Keywords: AI is generating video script and keywords...
Translation.Video Keywords Help: Leave blank to generate them with AI from the video script. Separate multiple keywords with English commas.
Translation.Clip Duration Help: Controls the duration of each clip used in the composition, not the total video length.
Translation.Clip Speed Help: Adjusts visual material playback only. Voiceover, subtitles, and the maximum output duration of each clip are unchanged.
Translation.Match Materials to Script Order Help: Generate keywords and match materials in script order so visuals follow the current voiceover.
Translation.Voiceover Volume Help: Adjusts automatic or uploaded voiceover volume. 100% keeps the original level.
Translation.Voiceover Speed Help: Applies only to automatic voiceover. 1.0× is the normal speed.
Translation.Upload Voiceover File Help: The uploaded audio is used directly instead of generating a voiceover.
Translation.Please Upload Voiceover File First: Please upload a voiceover file first
Translation.Custom audio will be used directly. TTS: Custom audio will be used directly. TTS synthesis will be skipped for this task.
Translation.Sonilo Music Prompt Help: Optional style or mood guidance, up to 2000 characters. Leave empty to let Sonilo match the video automatically.
Translation.Sonilo Multiple Videos Warning: Sonilo generates music separately for each output video, so multiple videos consume multiple generations.
Translation.Sonilo API Key Required: Enter a Sonilo API Key to use Sonilo background music.
Translation.Sonilo BGM Fallback Warning: Video {index} was generated without Sonilo background music because the music request failed.
Translation.ElevenLabs API Key Help: This key is shared with ElevenLabs TTS. It is masked and saved in your local config.toml.
Translation.ElevenLabs Music Prompt Help: Optional style or mood guidance, up to 1000 characters. Leave empty to let ElevenLabs match the video automatically.
Translation.ElevenLabs Multiple Videos Warning: ElevenLabs generates music separately for each output video, so multiple videos consume multiple generations.
Translation.ElevenLabs API Key Required: Enter an ElevenLabs API Key to use ElevenLabs background music.
Translation.ElevenLabs Connection Test Succeeded: ElevenLabs account and plan check passed. Music API access will be confirmed during generation.
Translation.ElevenLabs Paid Plan Required: The API Key is valid, but the ElevenLabs Music API requires a paid plan. Upgrade the account before generating music.
Translation.ElevenLabs BGM Fallback Warning: Video {index} was generated without ElevenLabs background music because the music request failed.
Translation.Custom Background Music File: Or Enter a Custom Music Path
Translation.Upload Background Music Help: Upload an MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, or WMA file up to 30 MB. It will be stored persistently when video generation starts.
Translation.Invalid Background Music: Please upload a valid supported background music file up to 30 MB.
Translation.Background Music Validation Failed: Background music could not be validated because FFmpeg or storage is unavailable. Please check the server logs.
Translation.Please enter a value between 0 and 100: Please enter a value between 0 and 100
Translation.Rounded Subtitle Background Help: Disabled by default. When enabled, subtitle backgrounds use a rounded translucent style that better fits the text width.
Translation.Subtitle Colors Are Indistinguishable: Subtitle text and background use the same color, so subtitles may not be visible.
Translation.Subtitle Font Does Not Support Text: The selected subtitle font does not support some script characters, so subtitles may be missing.
Translation.Generate Video Disabled Hint: A video is already being generated — wait for it to finish before starting another.
Translation.Video Script and Subject Cannot Both Be: Video Subject and Video Script cannot both be empty
Translation.You can download the generated video fro: You can download the generated video from the following links
Translation.LLM Fallback API Keys Hint: Extra API keys for the same provider, tried in order when the primary key fails (quota exhausted, invalid key, rate limit). Covers script, keywords, agentic planning and QA — the whole content creation process.
Translation.Groq Model List Load Failed: Unable to load Groq model list right now. You can still enter a model name manually; it will be validated during generation.
Translation.Groq API Key Required for Model List: Add a Groq API key to load available models automatically.
Translation.Get Help: If you need help, or have any questions, you can join discord for help: https://harryai.cc
Translation.Please Select a Valid Video Source: Please Select a Valid Video Source
Translation.Please Enter the Custom API URL and Key: Please Enter the **Custom API URL and Key**
Translation.No Video Source Provider Configured: No video source provider is configured. Enable at least one (Custom API URL/Key, Pexels, Pixabay, or Coverr) to use Auto.
Translation.Please Upload Local Materials First: Please upload at least one local material file first.
Translation.Unsupported Upload File Type: The uploaded file type is not supported.
Translation.Voice Example: This is an example text for testing speech synthesis
Translation.Estimated Voiceover Duration: Estimated full voiceover: about {min}–{max} sec (local estimate, no API call)
Translation.Voiceover Script Required: Add a video script to estimate and preview the full voiceover.
Translation.Full Voiceover Preview Cost Hint: A full preview calls the selected TTS service and may use API credits.
Translation.Voice Preview No Audio: The TTS service did not return preview audio. Check its settings and the application logs.
Translation.Voice Preview Busy: A video task is currently using the voice settings. Try again shortly.
Translation.Voice Preview Duration Unavailable: The preview audio was generated, but its duration could not be read. Check the application logs.
Translation.No voices available for the selected TTS: No voices available for the selected TTS server. Please select another server.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.azure-tts-v2: Requires an Azure Speech **region** and **API key**. Create or view them in the [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_ProjectOxford/CognitiveServicesHub/~/SpeechServices).
Translation.tts_provider_tips.siliconflow: Requires a SiliconFlow API key from the [console](https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/account/ak). Numeric speed and volume gain are supported.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.gemini-tts: Requires a Gemini API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). Pace and style are controlled through natural-language instructions.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.mimo-tts: Requires a Xiaomi MiMo API key; see the [first API call](https://mimo.mi.com/docs/quick-start/first-api-call). MiMo V2.5 controls pace and style through natural-language instructions.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.minimax-tts: Use a MiniMax TTS API key from the [China platform](https://platform.minimaxi.com/user-center/basic-information/interface-key) or [global platform](https://platform.minimax.io/user-center/basic-information/interface-key). The key and endpoint must belong to the same platform. If left empty, the MiniMax LLM key and its matching endpoint are reused.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.elevenlabs: Requires an [API key](https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys). Add voices to your favorites in the [Voice Library](https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library) first.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.chatterbox: Self-hosted. Run a compatible [Chatterbox TTS API](https://github.com/travisvn/chatterbox-tts-api), then enter a Base URL ending in `/v1`; the API key is usually optional.
Translation.Hide Basic Settings:
Hide Basic Settings

Hidden, the basic settings panel will not be displayed on the page.

If you need to display it again, please set `hide_config = false` in `config.toml`
Translation.Video Cache Management Help: Only automatically downloaded video materials are cleaned. Uploaded materials and generated videos are not affected. Do not clean the cache while generating a video.
Translation.Cache Cleanup Preview: This will clean {count} cache files and free approximately {size}.
Translation.Cache Cleanup Completed: Cache cleanup completed: deleted {count} files and freed {size}.
Translation.Cache Cleanup Completed With Failures: Cache cleanup partially completed: deleted {count} files and freed {size}; {failed} files could not be deleted.
Translation.Manual Step 1: Define niche & strategy — enable Agentic Planning, pick a Content Profile and fill the Content Intelligence context (niche, audience, platform). Optional.
Translation.Manual Step 2: Enter the video subject — the title the script is built around; choose the script language.
Translation.Manual Step 3: Tune script settings — paragraph count, target video length, custom requirements and system prompt under Advanced Script Settings.
Translation.Manual Step 4: Choose materials — source (Pexels, Pixabay, local files...), media type (images + videos vs videos only), image motion effect, aspect ratio and clip duration.
Translation.Manual Step 5: Set voice & music — TTS voice, volume/rate, background music and mixing.
Translation.Manual Step 6: Style subtitles — font, position, background and animations.
Translation.Manual Step 7: Generate — ReelSync builds script → terms → materials → audio → subtitles → final video and tracks progress in the Task Manager.
Translation.Manual Step 8: Review & learn — replay or regenerate any task.
Translation.Manual Feature 1: Agentic Planning — runs the strategy graph (topic analysis, strategy, hooks, narrative, script, critic) instead of a single generic prompt.
Translation.Manual Feature 2: Content Profile — a reusable persona steering tone, pacing, hooks, media and captions.
Translation.Manual Feature 3: Content Intelligence — niche/audience/platform context that adapts research depth, fact checking, narrative, titles and visuals.
Translation.Manual Feature 4: Discover Topics — generates scored topic candidates for your niche; pick one as the video subject.
Translation.Manual Feature 5: Task manager — replay or regenerate any past task from history.
Translation.Manual Feature 6: Task Manager — view running and completed tasks; replay, regenerate or delete them.
Translation.Onboarding Model Settings Description: After the tour, open Settings to choose a provider, enter the API key, Base URL, and model name, and test the connection.
Translation.Onboarding Creation Settings Description: Enter a topic, then adjust the video, audio, and subtitle options as needed. Most defaults can be used as-is.
Translation.Onboarding Generate Video Description: Start generation after confirming the settings. Track progress and open results from Task Manager at the top.
Translation.Regenerate Task Confirmation: Load this task's script and generation settings? This will replace the current form values, but will not modify the original task or video.
Translation.Task Restore Failed: This task does not contain reusable generation settings.
Translation.Task Configuration Loaded: The historical task configuration has been loaded. Review it, then click Generate Video.
Translation.Task Restore Local Materials Warning: Local materials cannot be restored automatically. Please upload them again.
Translation.Task Restore Custom Audio Warning: Custom audio cannot be restored automatically. Please upload it again.
Translation.Runtime Configuration Busy: A video task is using the current service settings. Try again after it finishes.
Translation.Video Encoder Help: Advanced option. Default follows the app's stable encoder policy, currently libx264. If a selected hardware encoder is unavailable, the app automatically falls back to libx264.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama:
##### Ollama Configuration
- **API Key**: not required
- **Base Url**: usually `http://localhost:11434/v1` for local runs or `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for Docker{docker_hint}
- **Model Name**: required; run `ollama list` and enter an installed model, such as `qwen:7b`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama.docker_hint: > Container environment detected. If Base Url is empty, `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` is used by default.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.openai:
##### OpenAI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [OpenAI Platform]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`; enter another endpoint when using a compatible service
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
> Accessing the official service may require a network proxy in some regions
Translation.llm_provider_tips.aihubmix:
##### AIHubMix Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in the [AIHubMix console]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another supported model ID
Translation.llm_provider_tips.aimlapi:
##### AIML API Configuration
- **API Key**: create one at [AIML API]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another supported model ID
Translation.llm_provider_tips.evolink:
##### EvoLink Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [EvoLink]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another supported model ID
Translation.llm_provider_tips.volcengine:
##### VolcEngine Ark Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in the Ark console; [register on VolcEngine]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; make sure the model is enabled in your Ark account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.oneapi:
##### OneAPI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in your own OneAPI deployment; see the [OneAPI project]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: required; enter the OneAPI service endpoint
- **Model Name**: required; enter a model ID configured in OneAPI
Translation.llm_provider_tips.qwen:
##### Qwen Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [DashScope]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dashscope/developer-reference/model-introduction#3ef6d0bcf91wy)
Translation.llm_provider_tips.azure:
##### Azure OpenAI Configuration
- **API Key**: obtain one from the [Azure Portal]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: required; enter the Azure OpenAI endpoint, such as `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com`
- **Model Name**: enter the Deployment Name; see the [deployment guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/create-resource)
Translation.llm_provider_tips.gemini:
##### Gemini Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [Google AI Studio]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.grok:
##### Grok Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in the [xAI Console]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.groq:
##### Groq Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in the [Groq Console]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; available models can also be loaded from the API
Translation.llm_provider_tips.deepseek:
##### DeepSeek Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [DeepSeek Platform]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.mimo:
##### Xiaomi MiMo Configuration
- **API Key**: create one by following the [MiMo documentation]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another supported model ID
Translation.llm_provider_tips.modelscope:
##### ModelScope Configuration
- **API Key**: create one by following the [ModelScope documentation]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list](https://modelscope.cn/models?filter=inference_type&page=1)
Translation.llm_provider_tips.cloudflare:
##### Cloudflare AI Gateway Configuration
- **API Key**: create a token in the [Cloudflare dashboard]({api_key_url}) with `AI Gateway - Read`, `AI Gateway - Edit`, and `Workers AI - Read` permissions
- **Account ID**: enter your Cloudflare account ID
- **Gateway ID**: defaults to `{default_gateway_id}`; you can also enter an existing Gateway ID
- **Base Url**: not required; the REST API endpoint is generated from the Account ID
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format for another model supported by AI Gateway
Translation.llm_provider_tips.minimax:
##### MiniMax Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [China platform](https://platform.minimaxi.com/) or [international platform](https://platform.minimax.io/)
- **Base Url**: use `https://api.minimaxi.com/v1` for China or `{default_base_url}` for international access (default)
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account

Make sure the API Key and Base Url belong to the same platform, or authentication may fail.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.pollinations:
##### Pollinations AI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [Pollinations]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID from the [model catalog](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models) that supports Chat Completions
Translation.llm_provider_tips.litellm:
##### LiteLLM Configuration
- **API Key**: not entered here; configure the target Provider key through environment variables
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format and see the [Provider list](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers)
Translation.Dynamic Auto-Sizing Help: Automatically scales the font size based on the actual text length: short text (e.g. "STOP!") grows up to 1.5×, long text shrinks to stay within two lines.
Translation.Enable Pop-in Bounce Help: The subtitle quickly scales from 0 to 1.1× within 0.15 seconds when it appears, then settles back to normal size.
Translation.Enable Floating Motion Help: The subtitle drifts smoothly up and down during its duration, always staying within the safe area.
Translation.Subtitle Preset Help: Apply a complete subtitle style. Selecting a preset fills in the settings below; changing any of them automatically switches back to Custom.
Translation.Subtitle Preset Switched To Custom Notic: Preset switched to Custom because you manually adjusted a setting.
Translation.Subtitle Vertical Offset Help: Nudge the subtitle up or down from its anchor position. 0 keeps the default placement.
Translation.Subtitle Highlight Color Help: Color used for the actively spoken word when word highlighting is enabled.
Translation.Subtitle Background Opacity Help: Opacity of the subtitle background when enabled.
Translation.Subtitle Active Word Highlight Help: Highlights the word currently being spoken in the highlight color.
Translation.Subtitle Dynamic Auto Avoidance Help: Smartly moves multi-line subtitles away from the bottom so they never leave the safe area.
Translation.Agentic Planning Help: Run the content-production graph instead of the single generic script prompt: topic analysis, content strategy, hook selection, narrative plan, script critique with revisions. The selected profile steers tone, pacing, hooks, media and captions.
Translation.Agentic Planning Enabled Hint: Agentic planning is enabled: the strategy agents will produce the script during generation. Choose a Content Profile to steer the output.
Translation.Auto Video Sources Help: Choose which providers participate in Auto mode. Order follows the built-in priority (Custom API, Pexels, Pixabay, Coverr, Web Scrape, Pollinations); providers without a configured key are skipped.
Translation.Free Mode Active: Free Mode: Pollinations provides free image material, no API key needed
Translation.Automation Level Help: Controls how many content decisions ReelSync makes for you. Assisted is the default: ReelSync recommends, you approve.
Translation.Research Notes Placeholder: Optional sources/notes, one per line. Used for fact grounding.
Translation.Zero-Key Research Metrics Help: External API requests made vs. requests avoided by the zero-key research layer (cache hits, deduplication, coalescing, batching, budget blocks).
Translation.Zero-Key Research Disabled Hint: The zero-key research layer is disabled. Enable it in the [research] section of config.toml (zero_key_enabled = true).
Translation.Social Profile URL Placeholder: Paste a TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X or YouTube profile link
Translation.Social Profile Import Hint: Imports your page's niche, audience and style into the fields below. Uses public search snippets and public page metadata (never private profile data); without a web-search provider or Web Video Scraping enabled it is model knowledge only.
Translation.Profile Import Failed: Profile import failed. Check the URL and try again.
Translation.Content Intelligence Hint: Content Intelligence adapts research depth, fact checking, narrative, titles and visuals to your niche, audience and platform.
Translation.Discover Topics Hint: Generate scored topic candidates for your niche; pick one to use as the video subject.
Translation.Discover Topics Error: Topic discovery couldn't reach the AI model
Translation.Discover Topics Error Hint: This usually means the AI API quota is exhausted, the key is invalid, or the network is blocked. Check your provider quota/key, then click Discover Topics again.
Translation.Publication Blocked By QA: Publication blocked by QA: critical issues were found.
Translation.Material Media Type Help: Images + Videos uses generated still images (with motion effects) alongside real video clips; Videos Only discards generated still images and uses real footage only.
Translation.Image Motion Effect Help: How still images are animated into video clips. Ken Burns is a slow zoom-in; Zoom In/Out, Slide and Fade give more pronounced motion.
Translation.Target Video Length Help: Controls how long the AI-written script will be. Auto follows the selected content profile's preferred length.
Translation.Manual Feature 7: Image Motion — still images are animated into clips with Ken Burns, zoom, slide or fade; pick Images + Videos media type to mix them with real footage.
Translation.Enable Overlays Help: Show title cards, fact/stat cards and key-phrase callouts on top of the video, aligned to the narration.
Translation.Overlay Style Help: Choose which overlay cards to render: title + facts, title only, facts only, callouts only, or everything.
Translation.LLM API Key Invalid: Your LLM API key is invalid or missing. Open Settings and update it.
Translation.LLM Rate Limited: Rate limit reached. Wait a moment and try again.
Translation.LLM Quota Exceeded: Provider quota or billing issue. Check your account with the LLM provider.
Translation.LLM Timeout: The LLM provider took too long to respond. Try again.
Translation.LLM Unreachable: Could not reach the LLM provider. Check your network or proxy settings.
Translation.LLM Request Failed: The LLM request failed. Check your provider configuration in Settings.
